question:
Select the segment in which a word has been INCORRECTLY used.

The children were so exhausted that they sank warily into bed.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Warily into bed**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word **warily** is **incorrect**.
 
• '​​​​Warily" means "cautiously; carefully."
 
• It does not fit in the context of the given sentence.
 
• The correct word is '​Wearily' which means "**With extreme tiredness**."
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The children were so exhausted that they sank **wearily__ **into bed*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• The synonyms of the word '​Wearily' are "**Casually, Desultorily, Halfheartedly**".
 
• Example of 'Wearily' i__n a__ sentence__:
 __
 
• *He sagged **wearily**__ back in his chair*.
